integrity.mathematical_basis: Structural proof of every minimal fort, fort-obstruction equivalence, explicit integer packing, and matching primal/lower-bound fractional certificates.
integrity.reproduction: Run the included standalone Python 3 verify.py using only the standard library. Its graph-level checks cover every vertex subset for n=3 through 8 and disjoint fort packings through n=7.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the crown graphs K_{n,n} minus one perfect matching, for every integer n at least 3; it does not cover arbitrary deleted bipartite subgraphs.
Exact formulas for all orders follow from a proved minimal-fort classification. Finite exhaustive computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
No uniqueness is claimed for optimal fractional assignments; publication priority remains provisional pending independent literature review.
title: Fort hypergraphs and the exact zero-forcing profile of crown graphs
